apiBase.source: CCMC Announcements: the DONKI Web API moved to https://ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/DONKI-API/get/... (2026-09-30), replacing the api.nasa.gov and kauai.ccmc URLs; parameters and response format unchanged, no API key

viewerBase.source: CCMC DONKI record pages (ccmc.gsfc.nasa.gov/DONKI/view/<type>/<id>/<version>, as in the records' own link field since the 2026 move); used only when a record carries no link of its own

windowDays.source: Game rule (Daily): the snapshot covers the seven whole UTC days before the day it is fetched

maxAge_days.source: Game rule (Daily): a snapshot whose window ended more than this many days before today is stale, and the Daily falls back to simulated weather

loadTimeout_ms.source: Game rule (Daily): how long the game waits for the snapshot file before flying with simulated weather

enlilLocation.source: NASA DONKI CME analyses: WSA-ENLIL runs list predicted impacts by location (Mars, Psyche, OSIRIS-APEX, Europa Clipper, Juice, …). Only Mars is flown so far

trackedLocations.source: Game rule: predicted impacts kept on each storm for future levels

glancingFactor.source: Game estimate: a glancing blow (ENLIL isGlancingBlow) halves every response's failure chance

minorFactor.source: Game estimate: a minor impact (ENLIL isMinorImpact) quarters every response's failure chance

maxStorms.source: Game rule (Daily): at most this many real storms, the most severe first
